name: Sudan
value: Famine risk spreads to South Darfur
summary: FEWS NET says Famine risk has spread to South Darfur and persists around Kadugli and Dilling; Kordofan fighting goes on
state: FEWS NET's September 2026 to January 2027 update says the risk of Famine has spread to parts of South Darfur, including Sharg Aj-Jabal, where acute malnutrition in two of four camps assessed exceeded the Famine threshold, and persists in parts of North Darfur and around Kadugli and Dilling in South Kordofan. On 8 Nov the army said it had downed a fourth drone in West Kordofan within a week and seized Ayal Bakhit and Umm Marahik near Al-Khuwei (Yeni Şafak, citing Anadolu); the claims could not be independently verified. Famine risk spreading to new areas keeps the Alert.
for_you: No direct risk to UK residents. The FCDO advises against all travel to Sudan. People with family there can follow FCDO travel advice and UN agency updates.
rubric_hit: Alert: famine spreading to new areas (FEWS NET: Famine risk extends to South Darfur)
